title: Paul before Festus and Agrippa II
summary: Paul is heard by Festus and Agrippa (Acts 25:23).
description: Paul is heard by Festus and Agrippa (Acts 25:23). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 60 AD (no higher-tier year available).
